notes: Homing pack (callee-host). 'the function at <entry>+0xNN' cites callees the page does not name (005A5B40, 006164B0, 005E3040). The idiom 'shr 0x1f; not al; test al, 1; je' skips the call when bit 31 is SET, so the rows say 'when bit 31 is clear'; 'mov eax, ecx; not al; test al, 1; je' on a pointer acts only when its bit 0 is clear. 005AD1B0: the per-slot null test is on the destination slot address, which starts non-null. 00610AE0: the 16 bytes at rsp+0x20 are only reloaded and re-stored in place before their address is passed; the body does not otherwise initialise them (doubt on how to phrase it). 005D2470 and 005D7720 set only al to 1. Anchor 0060C393 carries the two-word mnemonic 'rep stosq' exactly as the listing prints it.
